name: assetpanda/resource-cards
title: AP Resource Cards
description: Resource card grid after live's listing cards (photo, uppercase type label, category, title, excerpt, Read More →, in a light-ruled card), with the 'Showing 1–6 of N' line, numbered pagination (Previous / pages / Next) and an empty state. On a listing (variant grid) behaviour.js turns a click on a category tab (resource-hero's rail), a page number, an empty-state link back into the same listing, or a search of the same listing (resource-search's Enter / View all) into an in-place change: the leaving cards fade out, a skeleton holds the space while the filtered page is fetched, the new count, cards and pager fade and rise in with a short stagger, the listing's height is held so the tab rail never jumps, and the address, title and Back button follow; a page that turns out to be another listing, or any failure, loads normally; without JavaScript the links load the page as before. Variant related = the 'Related resources' row under an article: centred heading, three cards, no count or pagination. This block is an adapter — it holds no markup; it maps attributes to kit props.
